package.description: A Beautiful and Feature-rich Music & Video Player with YouTube Support, Built in Flutter

en-US.description: A Beautiful and Feature-rich Music & Video Player with YouTube Support, Built in Flutter
en-US.longDescription:
Namida is a music and video player with a modern, customizable UI and a rich feature set:
local library indexing with tag editing, lyrics (embedded/LRC/online), waveform seekbar, playlists, folders view, and detailed listening history and statistics.
It also includes a built-in YouTube client (playback, downloads, subscriptions, comments, history) and connects to self-hosted media servers (Subsonic/Navidrome, Jellyfin, WebDAV, SMB).
en-US.name: Namida
